data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): _VALID_COMBINATIONS must be enumerated as data with explicit cardinality. Pin the full set in task description: 2 directions x 7 actions = 14 candidate pairs. Per dd-2 and dd-5: invalid pairs include (outbound, clean_label), (outbound, repair_property), (inbound, probe) [probe is local-side per dd-5], (outbound, conflict) [conflict is Jira-side per dd-5]. Valid pairs are the remaining 10. Add test test_valid_combinations_set_has_expected_cardinality asserting len(_VALID_COMBINATIONS) == 10. Add parametrized test covering ALL 14 candidate pairs, marked valid/invalid per enumeration. Rationale: avoids implementer ambiguity on (inbound, probe) / (outbound, conflict) status (implicit_assumption).
